text:
ops-bot: ALERT: ap-southeast1 GPU eviction spike detected for gpu-pool-2, 27 pods evicted in last 10m :rotating_light:
maya: saw that, tail latency for hosted-api increased. getting customer tickets.
sudhir: looking at scheduler logs now. prelim thought: rack imbalance + taint churn causing dense pods to be moved and causing KV-cache warmups to thrash.
lina: any node-level hardware faults? thermal / nvlink?
jack: quick `kubectl get nodes -l pool=gpu-pool-2 -o wide` shows lots of NotReady briefly: `NODE            STATUS     ROLES   AGE`
jack: ```
gpu-34  Ready  gpu   34d
gpu-35  NotReady  gpu  10m
gpu-36  Ready  gpu  3d
```
maya: cloud metrics show a provisioning ripple: autoscaler created mixed-instance types, some with different GPU count which broke our fractional-gang placement assumptions.
sudhir: scheduler debug: ```I0512 12:01:23 scheduler.go:452] Preempting 3 pods due to taint match; affinityScore dropped; binpackScore negative```
sudhir: we also see the kube-scheduler applying hostAffinity constraints that prefer nvlink-enabled nodes, but the warmpool lacks them in this AZ, so it tries to pull from other racks -> cross-rack evictions.
tim: cost note — we started to drain an older rack (r-12) for maintenance, that left a bunch of small-slot GPUs in warmpool, so new big-gang jobs were forced to scatter.
lina: so fragmentation caused both latency and extra egress as models reloaded. can we short-term reduce gang size or relax nvlink affinity?
maya: suggested immediate mitigation: 1) apply a temporary nef:soft-affinity flag to workload group (low-risk), 2) expand warmpool in same rack, 3) run descheduler to consolidate small pods onto cold nodes.
jack: commands I ran: ```kubectl patch ds gpu-affinity -p '{"spec":{"template":{"metadata":{"annotations":{"redwood/soft-affinity":"true"}}}}}'```
sudhir: also toggled scheduler policy to avoid hard preempt for fractional-gang for 15m: updated configmap `kube-scheduler-config` -> `preemptionPolicy: soft` (we will revert).
maya: watching metrics now. eviction rate dropped from 2.7/min to 0.4/min after patch. tail latency back to baseline in ~3m.
tim: ops followups: create runbook for mixed-instance warmpool mismatch; add alert when warmpool AZ skew > 20% for gpu-pools.
lina: we should also add a placement probe that fails jobs requiring nvlink if enough nvlink nodes not present in same AZ.
jack: filing infra ticket: INFRA-4921 with logs + proposed rollback plan.
sudhir: plan for tomorrow: run simulator to see fragmentation with current fleet mix, then propose quantization of instance types per pool.
maya: +1. Thanks team — will update customer SLAs and postmortem if needed. :thumbsup:
